wizard.title: Create template
wizard.bodyPlaceholderPreview: The message body will appear here.
wizard.categoryHelp: Choose a category and subcategory. The template name and language are set in the edit step.
wizard.subcategoryHelp: The options change based on the selected category.
wizard.nameHelp: Lowercase English letters, numbers, and underscores only. Customers will not see this.
wizard.languageHelp: The language used for the template content. You can add more versions later.
wizard.authHelp: Only options actually supported when submitting to Meta are shown. One-tap and zero-tap login are not available yet.
wizard.otpHint: The body must include the {{1}} variable for the verification code.
wizard.securityRecHint: Adds a footer that recommends not sharing the code.
wizard.expiryHint: Meta shows a 10-minute expiry. There is no separate field supported in our connection yet.
wizard.copyCodeHint: You can add a copy button in the buttons section below.
wizard.reviewHelp: Make sure the details are correct before sending the template to Meta for review.
wizard.reviewWarn: Sending submits the template for Meta review. The status will stay pending until Meta returns approved or rejected.
wizard.submitted: The template was submitted for review. Status: {{status}}.
wizard.savedNoMeta: The template was saved as a draft because there is no active Meta connection.
wizard.bodyPlaceholder: Write the message body. Use {{1}} for variables.

MARKETING.title: Marketing
MARKETING.description: Promotions, product updates, and marketing messages. Sent only to customers who opted in.

UTILITY.title: Utility
UTILITY.description: Order updates, reminders, and replies to customer requests. Not intended for promotions.

AUTHENTICATION.title: Authentication
AUTHENTICATION.description: A one-time code for sign-in, identity verification, or confirming an action.

defaultMarketing.title: Default
defaultMarketing.description: Send messages with media and custom buttons to encourage customer engagement.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Send messages that help sales by connecting your product catalog.

callPermission.title: Call permission request
callPermission.description: Ask customers if you may call them on WhatsApp.

defaultUtility.title: Default
defaultUtility.description: Send messages about an existing order or account.

otp.title: One-time password
otp.description: Send codes to verify a transaction or sign-in.

metaEditor.contentHelp: Add a header, body, and footer to your template. Variables use {{1}}, {{2}}.
metaEditor.headerPlaceholder: Add a short text line for the message header
metaEditor.bodyHelp: You can add variables as {{1}}, {{2}}. The preview updates in real time.
metaEditor.exampleHelp: Meta requires a sample for every variable before review.
metaEditor.footerHelp: Short text at the bottom of the message. You can leave this empty.
metaEditor.footerPlaceholder: For example: Do not reply to this message
metaEditor.buttonsHelp: Create buttons so customers can reply or take an action. You can add up to {{count}} buttons.
metaEditor.contactHelp: Meta sets the button text. It cannot be edited.

quick_reply.title: Custom
quick_reply.description: The customer sends a short reply in one tap.

url.title: Visit website
url.description: Opens a static or dynamic website URL.

voice_call.title: WhatsApp call
voice_call.description: Starts a WhatsApp voice call with the business.

request_contact_info.title: Share contact details
request_contact_info.description: Asks the customer to share their contact details.

copy_code.title: Copy code
copy_code.description: Copies a promo or verification code to the clipboard.
